svg.title: Assembly technician — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as assembly technician, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A separate assembly peg aligns with a slotted fixture while a downward insertion arrow indicates the assembly direction. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a bob haircut, a rounded face and round glasses.
